theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), n ≤ d → d ≤ P → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ x ∈ T.support, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity T x θ → θ < 1 + δ → x ∈ regularSet T)
